units.source_text: 然而她们并没有谈到特别的事情。

en.t: However, they were not talking about anything in particular.

units.source_text: 源氏公子便不再听下去。

en.t: Prince Genji therefore stopped listening any further.

units.source_text: 他曾经听见她们说起他送式部卿家的女儿[\[26\]](#part1331.html#m26)牵牛花时所附的诗，

en.t: He had once heard them talk about the poem he had attached when he sent morning glories to the daughter of the Shikibukyo household[\[26\]](#part1331.html#m26),

units.source_text: 说得略有不符事实之处。

en.t: and their account had been somewhat at odds with the facts.

units.source_text: 他想：“这些女人在谈话中毫无顾忌地胡乱诵诗，不成样子。

en.t: He thought, "These women recite poems carelessly and without restraint in conversation; it is quite unseemly.

units.source_text: 恐怕见了面也不过如此吧。”

en.t: Even if I were to meet them, they would probably be no better than this."
